description: Operates the owner's own Mac apps through macOS accessibility, with window screenshots as a fallback, in the background: it does not activate apps or move the pointer, so the owner keeps working. action: list_apps; get_app_state (app) reads the app's accessibility tree, one element per line as [index] Role "title" …, launching it in the background if needed; click (element_index, or x and y in the latest screenshot's pixels; mouse_button, click_count); drag (from_x, from_y, to_x, to_y); type_text (text) into the focused element; press_key (key such as Return, Escape, cmd+a, cmd+shift+z); set_value (element_index, value); select_text (element_index, text, prefix, suffix, selection_type); scroll (element_index, direction, pages); perform_secondary_action (element_index, ax_action such as ShowMenu or Increment). Every action but list_apps needs app: a display name, bundle identifier or .app path. Indexes belong to the app's latest state; each action returns what changed, and lines it leaves out kept their index. screenshot adds a JPEG of the app's window; get_app_state includes one unless screenshot is false. Terminals, password managers and system authentication dialogs are refused. Ask before submitting, sending, buying or deleting anything the user did not ask for.
name: computer

full.description: get_app_state: the whole tree instead of what changed.
